headline: Nasdaq Plunges as Artificial Intelligence Concerns Resurface
summary: The tech-heavy Nasdaq led a broad market pullback as stocks reversed earlier gains following a resurgence of AI-related concerns.
why: The Nasdaq Composite is heavily weighted toward major technology and artificial intelligence firms, making it sensitive to shifts in sector sentiment.

impacts.name: Technology Sector
impacts.why: Renewed caution surrounding artificial intelligence valuations and growth projections pressured high-multiple tech stocks.

why_moved: A sudden shift in sentiment regarding the commercial trajectory and valuations of artificial intelligence technologies prompted aggressive selling in tech equities.
